title: Membership
subtitle: A subscription covers platform usage. Model calls are not billed here: you supply your own API key for every provider.
freeHint: Free accounts can use the platform default provider with no limits on calls, projects, or features.
paidHint: All model providers are unlocked. Configure them with your own API keys.
plansSubtitle: Every plan includes unlimited use of the default provider. Paid plans additionally unlock other providers.
freePlanNotPurchasable: The free plan needs no purchase
subscribeFailed: Could not create the order. Please retry, and contact an administrator if it keeps failing.
featureAllProviders: Other model providers, freely configurable with your own keys
featureNoCallFee: No per-call fee, you supply your own key
planFreeDesc: Start at zero cost with the default provider
planYearlyDesc: Best value for the long run
paymentManualInstructions: Send the order number above to an administrator. Your membership is activated as soon as the payment is confirmed.
loadFailedDesc: The network or the service may be temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
emptyPlansDesc: Plans have not been configured. Please contact an administrator.
renewReminderBody: After it expires the account falls back to the free tier and can only use the platform default provider. Renewing now extends from the current expiry date, so no remaining time is lost.
cancelOrderConfirm: The order will be voided and you can place a new one at any time.
orderExpiresHint: Unpaid orders are closed automatically after 24 hours.
